info: Alliance University Campus Treasure Hunt Official Questions Configuration

questions.title: Campus Clue
questions.question:
A crowd can gather here for a show or celebration,
With a roof above and room for a standing ovation.
It is not a classroom, yet the whole college may appear;
Find the covered place where events bring people near.

Where should you go?

questions.title: Campus Clue
questions.question:
At a certain hour, queues form and trays appear;
The sound of friends talking is often what you hear.
When lectures leave you hungry and lunch is the quest,
Find the campus place where many students eat best.

Where should you go?

questions.title: Campus Clue
questions.question:
A bowler runs in while a batter guards three wooden friends;
The game moves in overs, and the score rises at the ends.
Find the field where wickets fall and boundaries bring delight,
Where bat and ball decide who earns the right.

Where am I?

questions.title: Campus Clue
Campus Clue
questions.question:
Not quite a classroom, and not a sports field,
Yet hobbies and talents have room to be revealed.
Students come to take part, create, and explore;
Find the campus hub for activities and more.

Where am I?

questions.title: Campus Clue
questions.question:
A familiar dairy name is known across the land,
With a cheerful spotted mascot many understand.
For a cold treat or a dairy snack, this is a popular stop;
Find the campus outlet linked to that famous brand on top.

Where am I?

questions.title: Campus Clue
questions.question:
My name brings together two things that help life grow:
One comes from fields, the other makes rivers flow.
But here the clue points to a place where people dine;
Find the food spot whose name joins these signs.

Where am I?

questions.title: Campus Clue
questions.question:
I hold many stories, facts, and worlds inside,
Though my books stay still while your thoughts can travel wide.
Voices are kept low as curious minds explore;
Find the quiet place where knowledge fills each shelf and more.

Where am I?

questions.title: Campus Clue
questions.question:
For forms, records, permissions, and decisions to be made,
There is a place where official college work is laid.
It may not host your usual lecture or test;
Find the block where campus administration does the rest.

Where am I?

questions.title: Campus Clue
questions.question:
When hunger returns between one class and the next,
Students look for food to help them feel refreshed.
My name suggests plenty, and meals are the clue;
Find the campus food stop that matches these two.

Where am I?

questions.title: Campus Clue
Campus Clue
Campus Clue
questions.question:
Clothes arrive with stains from a busy day,
And leave much cleaner, ready to wear away.
Water and soap help me do my part;
Find the place that gives used clothes a fresh start.

Where am I?

questions.title: Campus Clue
questions.question:
When teaching hours end, lecturers need a place to stay;
Away from classrooms, they return at the close of the day.
Find the residential area connected to those who teach,
Where campus homes are within reach.

Where am I?

questions.title: Campus Clue
Campus Clue
Campus Clue
questions.question:
Heading for fun or heading to eat,
You will pass a red cube on this street.
Big, bold, and hard to ignore,
Your next hidden clue waits at its door!

Where am I?

questions.title: Mini Game
questions.question:
People come here carrying hopes they cannot hold,
And lower their voices though no sign may be told.
Look for the peaceful place where prayers are said,
And folded hands rise while bowed heads bend.

Where am I?

⚠️ Disclaimer: You must take the photo with the volunteer only after successfully passing the game.

questions.title: Mini Game
questions.question:
A ball rolls across the field, but hands must stay away;
Two goals wait at either end for teams to score and play.
Look for the place where boots race over the ground,
And cheers grow loud when the winning goal is found.

Where am I?

⚠️ Disclaimer: You must take the photo with the volunteer only after successfully passing the game.

questions.title: Mini Game
Mini Game
questions.question:
If you need a snack, a notebook, or something small,
This shop may have the answer among its shelves and all.
Many everyday items are gathered behind one door;
Find the campus store where you can browse for more.

Where am I?

⚠️ Disclaimer: You must take the photo with the volunteer only after successfully passing the game.

questions.title: Final Summit
questions.question:
You have reached LC1, but the ground floor is not the end;
Keep climbing upward, using the stairs as your friend.
When there are no more floors above your view,
The highest level of the MBA block is waiting for you.

Where am I?
